SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. 1. O. D. 69
Central F.B.
Date March 7th. 1929.

Subject (in full) Boris Butom

Made by P.J.S. Makluevsky. Forwarded by H.Kivans A.C. Pol.

Sir,

With reference to the attached report on Soviet activities
in Shanghai submitted by J.D.I. Prince, inquiries show that
Boris Butom, Russian Jew, suspected bolshevik, arrived in
Shanghai from U.S.S.R. in December 1923 and stayed alone at
the Crystal Hotel. In January he removed to 407 Avenue Joffre,
where he intends to open shortly a jewellery store for the sale
of jewellery alleged to have been confiscated by the Soviet
Government in Russia. It is reported that Boris Butom held
an important position while in U.S.S.R. but is not known to
have been active since his arrival in Shanghai. The French
Police have been informed of his present address and a further
report will be submitted in due course.

B. Maklaevsky.
P. J. S.

（批：AR. 9 3/4）
（批：J/D.J.I.）
（批：Foreign Section）
（批：Is it in your opinion worth while sending the above report to the authorities "）
（批：o.c. (Pol.)）
（批：Not in the meantime, something of importance might develop and then we could forward a more comprehensive report. 9/3/29）
（批：I agree MK）
（批：A.C. (Pol.) Let Prince to continue as well. It is just as well that he should do so. Sea）
（批：HR. Ds.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处登记室
编号 1. O. D. 69
中央巡捕房
日期 1929年3月7日。

事由（全称）鲍里斯·布托姆

制作人 P.J.S. 马克卢耶夫斯基。转呈人 H.基万斯 助理警务总监。

先生，

关于 J.D.I. 普林斯提交的有关上海苏维埃活动的附件报告，经查询显示，
鲍里斯·布托姆，俄籍犹太人，涉嫌布尔什维克分子，于1923年12月从苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟抵达上海，独自居住在晶华旅馆（Crystal Hotel）。1月，他搬至霞飞路407号，打算不久开设一家珠宝店，出售据称被俄国苏维埃政府没收的珠宝。据报道，鲍里斯·布托姆在苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟期间曾担任重要职务，但自抵达上海以来，未闻其有活跃活动。法租界警方已获知其现住址，并将适时提交进一步报告。

B. 马克拉耶夫斯基。
P. J. S.

（批：AR. 9 3/4）
（批：J/D.J.I.）
（批：外籍股）
（批：依你之见，是否值得将上述报告送交当局？）
（批：o.c. (Pol.)）
（批：暂时不必，可能会有重要情况出现，届时我们可以提交一份更全面的报告。1929年3月9日）
（批：我同意 MK）
（批：A.C. (Pol.) 让普林斯继续跟进也好。这样做是恰当的。Sea）
（批：HR. Ds.）

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. D. REGISTRY No 10 D 69 I.O. CHINESE SECTION. Station, ____ Date ____ Date FEBRUARY 28. 1929.）

ct (in full) ____ Soviet Activities in Shanghai.

Made by ____ C.D.I. Prince ____ Forwarded by ____

A Russian Jew, Boris Butom. (Борис Бутман),
Soviet Commissar, arrived here recently from Vladivostock. He
is at present residing at No. 407 Avenue Joffre. Under cover
of a Jewellery Store which he is about to open he is taking
up special work among Chinese Communists in Shanghai. Several
other Russians, Soviet agents, accompanied this man to Shanghai,
but their names and addresses are not to hand at present.
(These I hope to get in the near future.)

A.C.P. Pol.

（签名：C.D.I. Prince）
C.D.I.

Have you any information on the
above subject ?
JRS
28/2/29.）

069
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
File No. 69
Foreign Section
Date July 31, 1929.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

Sir,

With reference to your query of 30/7/29 Boris Butom was first reported on in consequence of a report concerning him forwarded by C.D.I.Prince on February 28, 1929 and subsequent reports forwarded by the Foreign Section were made to complete his political history.

As regards his reported arrest in Harbin the C.I.D. of Central Station are concerned to the following extent:

On July 22, 1929 Mrs. Linkovsky of the Siberian Jewellery Store, 27 Nanking Road reported that Boris Butom between June 3 and July 22 had received jewellery, etc., to the value of $4.000.00 from her, to sell on commission and had absconded. This property which had been pawned for $2.140.00 was recovered on July 23 by the CID Central. Please see Crime Report No. 2100 July 24.

Other reports have also been received at Central against Boris Butom, which are mostly civil.

On July 30, 1929 D.S.Masinkoff interviewed the French Police who stated they heard Boris Butom had been arrested in Harbin but could take no action until a reply was received from a telegram which they had sent to the Harbin Authorities.

I recommend this report be sent to D.S.Masinkoff who is now working on the case.

A/H Robertson
D. I.

（左侧手写批注：$11）
（左侧手写批注：R）

A/ D. C. I.
（底部手写批注：C.I.D. by. "A" please forward reference Crime Report No 2100 of July 24 31/7/29 See above pls.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处登记室
档案号 69
外籍股
日期 1929年7月31日。

(刑事调查处) 办公笔记

先生，

关于您1929年7月30日的查询，鲍里斯·布托姆首次被报告是因为 C.D.I. 普林斯于1929年2月28日转呈了一份关于他的报告，随后外籍股转呈了后续报告以完善其政治履历。

关于其在哈尔滨被捕的报告，中央巡捕房刑事调查处的关注程度如下：

1929年7月22日，南京路27号西伯利亚珠宝店的林科夫斯基夫人报告称，鲍里斯·布托姆在6月3日至7月22日期间，从她处接收了价值4,000.00美元的珠宝等物品，委托代售，随后潜逃。这批已被典当换取2,140.00美元的财物，于7月23日被中央巡捕房刑事调查处追回。请参阅7月24日的第2100号犯罪报告。

中央巡捕房也收到了针对鲍里斯·布托姆的其他报告，大多属于民事性质。

1929年7月30日，副警司马辛科夫采访了法租界警方，后者表示听说鲍里斯·布托姆已在哈尔滨被捕，但在收到他们发给哈尔滨当局的电报回复之前，无法采取行动。

我建议将此报告发送给目前正在处理此案的副警司马辛科夫。

A/H 罗伯逊
督察长。

（左侧手写批注：$11）
（左侧手写批注：R）

A/ 副督察长
（底部手写批注：刑事调查处 "A" 请转发参考7月24日的第2100号犯罪报告 1929年7月31日 见上文 请。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Foreign Section Station,
C. L. 69
Date July 30, 1929.

Subject (in full) Fraud committed by Boris Butom.

Made by D. S. Ovsiannikoff. Forwarded by Jno Rubinstein C.D.I.

Sir,

With reference to the attached file information has been received to the effect that Boris Butom, owner of the jewellery shop "Geneva" 407 Avenue Joffre, who defrauded several Russians/ jewellery stores in Shanghai and absconded on July 22, was arrested in Harbin by the Harbin Police and is temporarily detained in the latter city pending the arrival of an escort from Shanghai.

D. S. Masinkoff is conducting investigations in this case and I respectfully suggest that this file be sent to him for information.

H.R. 30/7/29
V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.

a/D.C.I.
D.S. Masinkhoff already knows this, and will submit a report as soon as he learns what the French Police are doing with a view to having Butom brought back to Shanghai. Butom was arrested as a result of a request sent to Harbin by the French Police.

A.C. (Pol)
Now does this concern us? Report.
Supt. Ea
30/7/29

A/ D. C. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

档案号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
外籍股 警局，
C. L. 69
日期 1929年7月30日。

事由（全称）鲍里斯·布托姆实施的诈骗。

制作人 D. S. 奥夫相尼科夫。转呈人 Jno 鲁宾斯坦 C.D.I.

先生，

关于附件档案，收到消息称，霞飞路407号“日内瓦”珠宝店店主鲍里斯·布托姆，诈骗了上海几家俄罗斯人/珠宝店，并于7月22日潜逃，已被哈尔滨警方在哈尔滨逮捕，并暂时拘押在该市，等待上海派出的押解人员到达。

D. S. 马辛科夫正在对此案进行调查，我谨建议将此档案送交他知悉。

H.R. 1929年7月30日
V. 奥夫相尼科夫
D. S.

a/副督察长
D.S. 马辛霍夫已知晓此事，一旦他获悉法租界警方为将布托姆引渡回上海所采取的行动，他将立即提交报告。布托姆是因法租界警方向哈尔滨发出的请求而被捕的。

助理警务总监 (Pol)
现在这与我们有关吗？报告。
 superintendent Ea
1929年7月30日

A/ 副督察长

SHANGHAI MERCURY, THURSDAY, JULY 25, 1929.

A MYSTERY OVER
JEWELLERY.

Russian Commission
Agent Leaves Suddenly.

Said to be in Possession of Big
Consignment.

The Russian community, and
especially that section of it
interested in jewellery, was astir
yesterday when it became known
that Boris Butom, the owner of
the jewellery shop, "Geneva," in
Avenue Joffre, had left Shanghai.
Boris Butom's custom was to
take jewellery on commission,
and dispose of same. In this
instance it is alleged that he had
jewellery to the value of about
$18,000 in his possession.
On Sunday last he called up
Mrs. Lipkovsky, the proprietress
of the Siberian Jewellery Store
in Nanking Road, and informed
her that he was going to Harbin
to meet his wife, who had
managed to get away from Soviet
Russia. On questioning him with
regard to the jewellery, he re-
plied that he would try to sell it
and, if unsuccessful, would return
it the following day.
Getting uneasy owing to not
having heard anything until late
in the afternoon, Mrs. Lipkovsky
telephoned to the shop, only to
be told that Mr. Butom had left
early on Monday morning for
Harbin by train.
Steps were immediately taken
to stop the man, and telegrams
were despatched in all directions,
but so far no news has been re-
ceived.
The French police have sealed
the shop, and a thorough in-
vestigation was made to-day.
Dr. O. Fischer is watching Mrs.
Lipkovsky's interests.

（批：32/）
（批：Mls 27:7:29）
（批：Int. Sec. lca）

(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 27 / 7 / 29

《上海泰晤士报》，1929年7月25日，星期四。

珠宝之谜。

俄罗斯佣金
代理人突然离开。

据称持有大批
货物。

俄罗斯侨民社区，尤其是其中对珠宝感兴趣的那部分人，昨天得知霞飞路“日内瓦”珠宝店店主鲍里斯·布托姆已离开上海后，为之震动。
鲍里斯·布托姆的习惯是接受珠宝委托代售。在此案中，据称他手中持有价值约18,000美元的珠宝。
上周日，他致电南京路西伯利亚珠宝店的女店主利普科夫斯基夫人，告知她他将前往哈尔滨去见他的妻子，他的妻子已成功逃离苏维埃俄国。当就珠宝一事质问他时，他回答说他会尝试出售，如果不成功，第二天就会归还。
由于直到下午很晚都没有听到任何消息，利普科夫斯基夫人感到不安，便打电话到店里，却被告知布托姆先生已于周一清晨乘火车前往哈尔滨。
当局立即采取措施拦截此人，并向各方发送了电报，但至今未收到任何消息。
法租界警方已查封该店，并于今天进行了彻底调查。
O. 费舍尔博士正在维护利普科夫斯基夫人的利益。

（批：32/）
（批：Mls 1929年7月27日）
（批：情报股 lca）

政治科
（外籍股）
日期 1929年7月27日
